interpretation: launchd.ios is Apple's launchd exec'd as PID 1 by the ramfs init (init.c runs /sbin/launchd.ios), so the allowlist entry 'launchd' did not match its p_comm. SpringBoard's main thread is blocked on a synchronous request to a plain (connection) port whose receive right is inside one of three undelivered messages queued on a service port still held by launchd. This matches an XPC client connecting to a MachService whose job has not been launched or has not checked in: until the job takes the service port from launchd, the connection port stays in transit and the reply never arrives.
next: Both scopes are consumed. The next probe should export the holding service port's launchd service name and domain from its ipc_service_port_label (CONFIG_SERVICE_PORT_INFO is enabled), identifying which job SpringBoard is waiting for.
